justification: On August 5, 2019, the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) to strengthen the sustainable management, protection, development, and rehabilitation of 143 watersheds supporting National Irrigation Systems (NIS) nationwide. Pursuant to DENR Memorandum Circular No. 2008-05, the agreement establishes the respective responsibilities of both agencies in preparing Integrated Watershed Management Plans (IWMPs), identifying priority watersheds for rehabilitation, securing environmental clearances, enforcing forestry laws, conducting research and information campaigns, and mobilizing funding resources. The partnership adopts an integrated watershed ecosystem management approach to ensure the long-term sustainability of irrigation systems while promoting environmental conservation and effective watershed management.
